Cc: Santiago Morales <s.morales@acme-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Request: opt-out exception + TFC carveout for pilot (Order Form v3)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Legal and procurement reviewed the draft order form and have one last ask before we proceed to signatures. For our pilot we need an opt-out / termination-for-convenience carveout limited to the pilot environment only (30 days notice, no post-pilot TFC). We can accept standard auto-renew mechanics for the full production environment but need the pilot to be cancellable without long-tail liabilities.

Attached: Acme_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (annotated by Acme legal); TFC_proposal_summary.xlsx (internal cost impact).

Can Redwood legal confirm whether a pilot-only TFC carveout is viable (and if so, any fee or data return requirements you need from our side)? Also please confirm whether the opt-out notice window can be 30 calendar days rather than 60.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme.io

Subject: RE: Request: opt-out exception + TFC carveout for pilot (Order Form v3)

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the annotated draft. Appreciated. I pulled in Karthik (sales lead on the deal) and Mina (legal ops) to scope the ask. High level thoughts: we typically keep Term/Auto‑Renew uniform between pilot and production to avoid entanglement, but we do support constrained pilot exceptions in limited cases with guardrails (notice window, limited liabilities, data disposition).

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik: provide commercial posture on whether a pilot TFC (30d) is acceptable and any offset (credits/early-exit fee).
- Mina/legal ops: quick scan for compliance / recordkeeping implications (esp. keys/data export) and confirm if 30d is operationally feasible.
- I'll share a one‑page exception scope to land language we can redline into the order form.

If we can get buy-in on the compromise we usually ask for: 30d pilot TFC limited to the sandbox project id(s), no TFC exposure for production, and a pro‑rata refund of pre-paid usage for unused months OR a flat pilot wind‑down fee (example: 10% of MRR for remaining month). Can you confirm Acme preference on refund vs fee?

I'll aim to send the exception scope doc by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (referenced) — I will upload the exception scope as a doc link after drafting.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: opt-out exception + TFC carveout for pilot (Order Form v3)

Priya / Jordan — quick commercial take. We want to avoid open-ended TFC on production. For pilot-only we can accept a 30-day opt-out limited to the sandbox project(s) listed in the order form if Acme agrees to one of the following operational mitigants (pick one):

1) Pro‑rata credit for unused paid months OR
2) One-time pilot wind-down fee equal to 10% of the remainder of committed spend for the month (min $5k) OR
3) Escrow of customer usage data export costs (Acme pays export if requested within 30d).

Practically, we prefer option 1 or 2. I attached a tracked-changes doc (Acme_OrderForm_v3_karty_changes.docx) with in-line commercial language: pilot project id list, 30d notice, explicit exclusion of production bundles from the pilot TFC, and a clause for data return within 14 days.

Jordan — which of the mitigants would you prefer to present to procurement/legal at Acme? If you want, I can leave the redline with the 10% fee as fallback.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales — Strategic Accts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Acme_OrderForm_v3_karty_changes.docx (DOCX, tracked changes)

From: Santiago Morales <s.morales@acme-legal.com>

Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: opt-out exception + TFC carveout for pilot (Order Form v3)

Priya / Karthik — attaching our annotated counter‑redline. We are prepared to accept a pilot-only TFC limited to the sandbox project identifiers and a 30-day calendar notice. Our preference is pro‑rata refund (option 1) rather than a fee; simplifies procurement approvals. We did add a short data disposition paragraph: Redwood returns or securely deletes sandbox data within 14 days of termination and provides an export in standard JSON/CSV at Acme’s request.
